description: Create a named timeline marker at a frame (or time in seconds), with optional colour and length, in one call (c4d.documents.AddMarker). Replaces the old workaround of seeking the playhead and firing the 'Create Marker at Current Frame' command, which could only drop unnamed markers. Returns the marker's info including its `index` handle for set_marker / remove_marker.

color.description: Marker colour as [r, g, b] floats in 0..1.

length_frames.description: Marker length in frames (default 0 — a point marker).

name: create_marker
title: Create Timeline Marker
